reference.name: Edit actions selected-record context resets automatically
reference.summary: Selecting the Record(s) selected context in Companies > Edit actions automatically reverts to No record selected, deselects the row, and removes the selected-record action set without further input.
reference.expected: After choosing Record(s) selected, the dropdown and selected-record action panel remain in that context until the user changes it.
reference.actual: The selection initially took effect: the dropdown showed Record(s) selected, one company row was checked, and record-specific actions appeared. On the independent repeat, about 2.8 seconds later and without user input, the dropdown changed to No record selected, the row was unchecked, and the panel returned to unselected actions. The same reset also occurred on the first attempt.
reproSteps: Start signed in to the authorized Tim Apple workspace using the provided saved authenticated session; do not change authentication details.
On the Companies view at /objects/companies?viewId=76ab92b8-5254-4f7c-9ed1-35a713200052, open Edit actions.
Open the No record selected context dropdown and choose Record(s) selected. Confirm the dropdown, selected table row, and record-specific actions update.

Without further interaction, wait about 3 seconds. Observe the dropdown return to No record selected, the row become unchecked, and the panel return to unselected actions. The same behavior was independently observed again during a 10-second wait.
Click Cancel to exit layout customization without saving.

knownHits.reason: Both describe row selection and selected-record actions clearing automatically without input. This finding reaches the failure through ordinary People-list selection rather than Edit actions.
